verdict.rationale: Grafana's core value prop is unified metrics/logs/traces exploration with shared context: exemplars linking Prometheus metrics to Tempo traces, seamless metrics-to-logs pivoting with preserved label filters, Tempo linking traces with logs/metrics, split-view/drilldown across data sources, and incident response workflows that let SREs investigate with the same metrics/logs/traces that fired an alert. Independent community commentary corroborates it as the de facto cross-source consolidation platform. missing for 10: no deep hands-on validation of trace-to-log correlation quality or friction reported at scale.
